jobs.title: Lead Data Engineer
jobs.description: About Better Collective Sports media at scale, running on data Better Collective is a global sports media group, reaching more than 400 million monthly visits across a portfolio of leading sports media brands. We build products and experiences that make sports more engaging and accessible for fans around the world. Behind that sits a large and diverse technology and data landscape, spanning markets, brands and business models. We work in a collaborative environment where people are encouraged to challenge how things are done, take ownership and help shape what comes next. The domain Paid media is where the data has to pay off. We spend real money across dozens of ad networks every day. Which campaigns scale, which creatives get cut, which markets get more budget: those calls come out of the models this team builds. Ad platform spend and delivery, affiliate and operator revenue, CRM data, all stitched into one user-level view of what a click was actually worth. That model exists and it works. It is also the most demanding domain on our data platform - the most sources, the fastest schema churn, and the shortest patience for a table that landed late. We are looking for the engineer who owns it. Where this role sits A central platform team sets the how. You set the what. Better Collective runs a hub and spoke data organisation. A central data platform team owns the platform itself - MotherDuck, dbt, Dagster, DLT, the golden paths, the standards, the infrastructure. Paid Media Insights is a domain team, a spoke, that builds on it. The split is deliberate and we hold to it. The platform team decides how data is produced here. You decide what paid media produces, and you own everything we run. So you are not starting a new stack, and you are not going to spend your year on plumbing that a central team should be solving once for everyone. You are, however, expected to be a demanding customer. When a golden path does not fit paid media, we want you to say so and push for it

jobs.description: Build a Safer World. TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure. As a Senior Data Engineer on the Graph Analytics team, you will build scalable graph systems that analyze large networks of cryptocurrency transactions. You will collaborate closely with engineers, data scientists, and investigators to design mission-critical graph algorithms that analyze flows of funds. You will leverage distributed databases and graph processors to implement real-time graph algorithms at the multi-blockchain scale. You will collaborate with data science teams to identify opportunities to apply tools and techniques from graph theory to a variety of predictive learning problems. jobs.description: For one of our clients, we are looking for an Advanced Data Engineer to build and maintain data pipelines and data products. You will work directly with clients to understand their needs and turn diverse data sources into reliable, reusable datasets. Design, develop, test and monitor distributed data pipelines for batch and streaming workloads. Integrate structured and unstructured data and produce reproducible datasets that meet the needs of data consumers. Advise clients on technical options and explain design decisions to technical and business stakeholders. Work with architects, software engineers and data scientists to deliver data products iteratively. Degree in computer science, software engineering, data science or a comparable qualification. At least three years of experience in data engineering or software engineering. Practical Python and SQL skills and hands-on experience with relational and non-relational databases. Experience building and maintaining data products, with knowledge of architectures such as data lakes, lakehouses and medallion architectures. Experience with cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric or Amazon SageMaker. Familiarity with large-scale data processing, data analysis and visualisation, as well as agile development and DevOps. Hands-on experience with or interest in technologies such as Spark, Delta Lake, Airflow, Kafka, Kubernetes or Terraform. Fluent German and English.
